book.name: 4 Mose (Numeri)
book.title: Numeri Mose Nwoma A Ɛtɔ So Ɛnan

content: Afei, Balaam hunuu sɛ Awurade pɛ sɛ ɔhyira Israel. Yei enti, wankɔ abisa sɛdeɛ ɔtaa yɛ no. Na mmom, ɔtoo nʼani hwɛɛ ɛserɛ no so,
hunuu sɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo no abobɔ wɔn atenaeɛ. Afei, Onyankopɔn honhom baa ne so,
na yei ne nkɔmhyɛ a ɔmaaeɛ:

content.text: nkɔmhyɛ a ɛfiri ɔbarima a nʼani hunu adeɛ yie,
deɛ ɔhunu anisoadeɛ a ɛfiri Otumfoɔ hɔ;
na ɔda fam, a nʼani gu so:
Ao Israel, mo afie yɛ ahomeka.
te sɛ nturo frɔmfrɔm wɔ asubɔnten ho.
Wɔte sɛ pɛperɛ a Awurade adua,
te sɛ ntweneduro a ɛbɛn nsuo ho.
Wɔn mma bɛnya deɛ ɛhia wɔn nyinaa.
Ɔsɛe amanaman a wɔtia no nyinaa,
ɔte sɛ gyataburu, na hwan na ɔbɛtumi anyane no?
“Ao Israel, nhyira nka obiara a ɔhyira wo,
na nnome nka obiara a ɔdome wo.”

content: Ɔhene Balak bo fuu Balaam. Ɔde Abufuo bɔɔ ne nsam guu ne so teaam sɛ, “Mefrɛɛ wo sɛ bɛdome, mʼatamfoɔ nanso woahyira wɔn mprɛnsa.
Firi me so kɔ! Sane kɔ wo nkyi! Meyɛɛ mʼadwene sɛ anka mɛhyɛ wo animuonyam, nanso, Awurade de akame wo!”
Balaam buaa no sɛ, “Wonkae asɛm a meka kyerɛɛ wʼasomafoɔ no? Mekaa sɛ,
‘Sɛ Balak ma me ahemfie a wɔde dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ ahyɛ hɔ ma koraa a, menni tumi sɛ mɛyɛ biribi atia Awurade apɛdeɛ.’ Meka kyerɛɛ wo sɛ asɛm a Awurade aka no nko ara na mɛka.
Afei, meresane akɔ me nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn. Nanso, deɛ ɛdi ɛkan no, ma menka deɛ Israelfoɔ no bɛyɛ wo nkurɔfoɔ daakye no nkyerɛ wo.”
Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛdi Akyire No
Yei ne nkɔmhyɛ a Balaam de maeɛ:

content.text: nkɔmhyɛ a ɛfiri ɔbarima a nʼani hunu adeɛ yie,
deɛ ɔwɔ nyansa a ɛfiri Ɔsorosoroni no
deɛ ɔhunu anisoadeɛ a ɛfiri Otumfoɔ hɔ;
na ɔda fam, a nʼani gu so:
na Seir a ɔyɛ ne ɔtamfoɔ no, wɔbɛdi ne so nkonim,
na Israel bɛkɔ so adi nkonim.
Ɔhene bi bɛsɔre wɔ Yakob mu

content: Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛtɔ So Enum
Afei, Balaam hwɛɛ Amalekfoɔ fie hyɛɛ nkɔm sɛ,

content.text: “Amalek na na ɛyɛ aman nyinaa abakan,

content: Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛtɔ So Nsia
Afei, ɔhwɛɛ Kenifoɔ hyɛɛ nkɔm sɛ,

content.text: wanwono mo pirebuo wɔ abotan mu.
ɛberɛ a Asurhene afa mo nnomum.”

content: Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛtɔ So Nson
Nsɛm a ɔde wiee ne nkɔmhyɛ no ne sɛ:

content.text: “Aa, sɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ sei a, hwan na ɔbɛtena nkwa mu?
Nanso wɔn nso, wɔbɛsɛe wɔn pasaa.”

content: Enti, Balaam ne Balak sane kɔɔ wɔn kurom.
